statement: When a write response is unsuccessful or unreadable, the public client does not disclose an internal transaction ID as though the write's outcome were known; callers may resolve an unknown outcome only by resending the exact facts with the same graph-scoped token.

enforcedAt.trigger: Public Worker handles a transaction request whose result is not a valid committed witness

frames.note: Routes the public transaction request to the transaction dispatcher.
Returns only the txId on a verified committed response and strips txId from failure bodies.
Reports network/read failures as errors without fabricating a transaction receipt.

consequence: Callers cannot confuse uncertain delivery with a known commit and can safely retry one logical request using its exact token and payload.
